- Smaller app: the torrent engine's native part (libtorrent, 16 MB on the phone and 6 MB of the APK) is no longer built in: it is fetched only when you ask: a torrent download that needs it shows "Download the torrent engine (6 MB)" on its row (from Maven Central, checked by its SHA-256), and the downloads that waited go on. The gallery's smart search (objects and faces, 5 MB) is downloaded only from the button in the search or in Gallery settings > Smart search, where it can be removed again; it reads each picture once and remembers it. The x86_64 libraries (emulators and Chromebooks) and the 1 MB tables of a post-quantum signature never used here are left out. The full APK is about 18 MB smaller, the space on the phone about 35 MB less.
- Downloads, Series and movies: when the add-on gave nothing, every episode showed "—" and the download buttons did nothing, with no word why. The add-on's answer is now checked: a refusal (an HTTP error or a protection web page instead of a list) is said under the list ("The add-on did not answer: HTTP 403"), the request looks like a phone browser's, and a stream that does not say its size is no longer thrown away (the first one is taken when none says it).
- Downloads, Series: every episode has a new button that lists all its streams (quality, source and size, the ones under the size limit marked): one is chosen and downloaded, instead of only the one picked by size. Each season card shows a picture of its own (its first episode's), not the same series poster for all.
- Ambient sounds (Focus, White noise): the 20 built-in loops (8 MB) were inside the app and copied once more into its folder, so they took twice the space. They are now downloaded only from the "Download the sounds (8 MB)" button at the top of White noise (from this project's repository at a fixed commit, each checked by its SHA-256).
